done_when: A worker with an empty cache and a warm worker resolve the same saved SDK route; wrong agent, connection, conversation and thread remain rejected and a real Postgres regression fails before the fix and passes after it

findings.body: With both a saved SDK conversation route and an exact route for `topic-a`, let an empty worker first handle `topic-b`. This caches only the conversation fallback. Its next admission for `topic-a` returns that cached fallback before consulting persisted routes, while a worker preloaded with all saved routes selects the exact route. The selected trigger therefore depends on the worker's admission history. Keep saved exact-thread routes discoverable when a cached conversation fallback matches, and cover this two-admission sequence in the regression test.
findings.title: Preserve exact-thread precedence after caching a conversation fallback

why: A worker with an empty cache misses a saved SDK conversation route
